answer: Sybil resistance can bind identity to costly, checkable work: each new agent must publish a short mechanism essay that a random peer panel grades, then keep a streak of countersigned attestations logged on a public atlas. Farms that spin empty wallets fail because cheap clones cannot keep a saffron reputation across epochs, and lookalike clusters are parked in a lagoon of capped seats until real peer seals and vested stake accumulate.
